fields.description: Einstein Lead Score (1-99) copied from ScoreIntelligence by LeadScoreSyncBatch. Kept when the ScoreIntelligence record is deleted; not updated after conversion.
fields.helpText: Einstein Lead Score, refreshed by a scheduled job. Retains the last known score if Einstein removes it, and stops updating once the lead converts.

queries.name: AC_Compare
queries.sqlPreview:
SELECT 
    Id, 
    Email, 
    FirstName, 
    LastName, 
    Purchased__c, 
    Declined__c, 
    UTM_Source__c, 
    HasOptedOutOfEmail, 
    et4ae5__HasOptedOutOfMobile__c,
    Mobile_Country_Code__c,
    Vehicle_Make__c,
    Vehicle_Model__c,
    LandingPageID__c,
    CreatedDate,
    Mobile_Opt_Out_Date__c
FROM 
    ent.lead_Salesforce
WHERE 
    CAST(CreatedDate AS DATE) >= CAST(DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)
    AND LandingPageID__c LIKE '%compare%'

queries.name: AC_Compare_v2
queries.sqlPreview:
SELECT 
    id,
    email,
    cookieid__c,
    mobile_country_code__c,
    firstname,
    lastname,
    createddate,
    max_quote_step__c,
    state__c,
    utm_source__c,
    landingpageid__c,
    lastmodifiedbyid,
    purchased__c,
    declined__c,
    trial_mode__c,
    saved_quote__c,
    hasoptedoutofemail,
    mobile_opt_out_date__c
from ent.[Lead_Salesforce]
where cast(createddate as date) >= cast(getdate() - 3 as date)
and email not in (select emailaddress from Emails_Sent_Last_14_Days)
and landingpageid__c like '%compare%'
and (utm_source__c is null or (utm_source__c not like '%MediaAlpha%'))

    a.Property_Ownership_Status__c,

    a.et4ae5__HasOptedOutOfMobile__c,
    a.MailingState,

    a.HIGoal_DFDR_Goal__c,
    a.higoal_rewards_total__c,
    ISNULL(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DAY, a.Policy_Effective_Date__c, GETDATE()) / 7) + 1, 0)
      AS WeeksSinceInception,
    CASE WHEN a.MailingState = 'RI'
          AND a.Driver_Role__c = 'PNI'
          AND a.Policy_Effective_Date__c IS NOT NULL
          AND FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DAY, a.Policy_Effective_Date__c, GETDATE())/7)+1 >= 5
          AND ISNULL(a.higoal_rewards_total__c, 0) < 50
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsRIEligible,
    CASE WHEN a.Policy_Effective_Date__c > s.LaunchDate
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsNewCustomer

SELECT rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(c.Id as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Id, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(c.SMS_Policy_Opt_In__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as SMS_Policy_Opt_In__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(c.Phone as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Phone, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(c.email as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as email, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.non_pay__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as non_pay__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.Nonpay_Cleared_At__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Nonpay_Cleared_At__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.Nonpay_Cancel_Notice_Created_At__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Nonpay_Cancel_Notice_Created_At__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.Latest_Payment_Date__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Latest_Payment_Date__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(c.Cancel_date__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Cancel_date__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.Total_Payment_Amount__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Total_Payment_Amount__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.Invoice_Due_Date__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as Invoice_Due_Date__c, rtrim(left(coalesce(CAST(b.policy_number__c as char(255)),'<null>'), 255)) as policy_number__c from ent.Contact_Salesforce c
INNER JOIN ent.Bill__c_Salesforce b
    ON c.Customer_Number__c = b.Customer_Number__c
WHERE b.Invoice_Due_Date__c >= DATEADD(day, -21, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
    AND b.policy_number__c NOT LIKE '%R'
    AND (
        (b.Total_Payment_Amount__c > 0
            AND b.Latest_Payment_Date__c >= b.Invoice_Due_Date__c)
        OR b.Nonpay_Cleared_At__c IS NOT NULL
        OR c.Cancel_date__c IS NOT NULL
    )

LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@msn.com' THEN 'microsoft' WHEN LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@aol.com' THEN 'aol' WHEN LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@cox.net' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@comcast.net' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@att.net' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@sbcglobal.net' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@verizon.net' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@charter.net' THEN 'isp' WHEN LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%.edu' THEN 'edu' WHEN LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@proton.me' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@protonmail.com' OR LOWER(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.To_Email_Address__c) LIKE '%@mail.com' THEN 'privacy' ELSE 'other' END AS Email_Domain__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__StateProvinceId__c AS State__c,

  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Saved_Quote__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Saved_Quote__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Currently_Insured_Status__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Currently_Insured__c,

  CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.Opened__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Opened_First_Email__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.Clicked__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Clicked_First_Email__c,
  MAX(first_send.First_Send_At__c) AS First_Send_At__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Created__c,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(first_send.First_Send_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Days_Create_To_Send__c,
  MAX(HOUR(first_send.First_Send_At__c)) AS Send_Hour__c,
  MAX(HOUR(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Hour__c,
  MAX(DAYOFWEEK(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Day_Of_Week__c,
  MAX(MONTH(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Created_Month__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS Max_Quote_Step__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Credit_Score__c) AS Credit_Score__c,
  COUNT(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Send_Rows__c
FROM (SELECT ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c AS Lead_Id__c, MIN(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c) AS First_Send_At__c FROM ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm WHERE ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EmailName__c LIKE 'AC_%' AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c LIKE '00Q%' GROUP BY ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c) AS first_send
JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm ON (ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c = first_send.Lead_Id__c)
JOIN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm ON (ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c = first_send.Lead_Id__c AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c = first_send.First_Send_At__c)
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) <= 700
  AND DATEDIFF(first_send.First_Send_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(first_send.First_Send_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) <= 30
  AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), first_send.First_Send_At__c) >= 8
  AND (ssot__Lead__dlm.Internal_Traffic__c IS NULL OR ssot__Lead__dlm.Internal_Traffic__c = FALSE)
GROUP BY Lead_Id__c, First_Email_Name__c, Email_Domain__c, State__c, Previous_Insurance__c, Vehicle_Make__c, UTM_Source__c, UTM_Medium__c, Lead_Source__c, Publisher__c, Email_Opt_Out__c, Declined__c, Saved_Quote__c, Currently_Insured__c, Mobile_Opt_Out__c, Has_Mobile__c, App_Downloaded__c, Opened_First_Email__c, Clicked_First_Email__c

calculatedInsights.displayName: Data Quality CI: Contact Points per Indv
calculatedInsights.description: Review the number of contact points for each source record to find outliers. Outliers can help you identify issues with your source data or data mappings. Use this calculated insight after data ingestion, but before creating an identity resolution ruleset
calculatedInsights.expression:
/********************************************************************************************************
Data Quality Calculated Insight: Contact Points Per Individual
https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=data.c360_a_resolution_troubleshooting_ci_contact_points_for_individuals.htm&type=5
Created Date: 9/3/2025
Created By: Jim Ziller - Cognizant


********************************************************************************************************/

SELECT
 ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Individual_Id__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT( ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS unq_Email_CPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT( ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS unq_Phone_CPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT( ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS unq_Address_CPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT( ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS unq_Party_Identifiers__c
FROM ssot__Individual__dlm
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm ON ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm ON ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm ON ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm ON ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
GROUP BY
 Individual_Id__c

select contacts.unified_id as unified_id__c,
	contacts.contact_id as contact_id__c,
	sum(round(contacts.months_active,0)) as months_active__c,
	first(contacts.cancelled_flag) as cancelled_flag__c
from (
	select
	UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c as unified_id,
	ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c as contact_id,
	case when ssot__Individual__dlm.Cancel_Date__c is null then months_between(current_date(),ssot__Individual__dlm.Policy_Effective_Date__c)
		else months_between(ssot__Individual__dlm.Cancel_Date__c, ssot__Individual__dlm.Policy_Effective_Date__c)
		end as months_active,
	case when ssot__Individual__dlm.Cancel_Date__c is null then false
		else true
		end as cancelled_flag
	from UnifiedIndividual__dlm
	inner join IndividualIdentityLink__dlm on UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c
	inner join ssot__Individual__dlm on ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c
	where ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c like '003%'
) as contacts
group by contacts.unified_id, contacts.contact_id

calculatedInsights.displayName: Identity Res CI: Outlier Unified Profile
calculatedInsights.description: Review the number of matched contact points for each unified profile. A high number of matches per contact point, like profiles with hundreds of source records matched with the same email address, could indicate issues with data quality or source data.
calculatedInsights.expression:
/********************************************************************************************************
Identity Resolution Calculated Insight: Outlier Unified Profiles
https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=data.c360_a_resolution_troubleshooting_ci_outlier_unified_profiles.htm&type=5
Unified Individual - CP Summary
Created Date: 9/3/2025
Created By: Jim Ziller - Cognizant

Review the number of matched contact points for each unified profile. A high number of matches per contact point, like profiles with hundreds of source records matched with the same email address, could indicate issues with data quality or source data. Use this calculated insight after creating unified profiles with an identity resolution ruleset.

Tip 
- Use this calculated insight for multiple rulesets by creating a calculated insight for each Unified Data Model Object (DMO).
- To search for outlier profiles in Profile Explorer, use the Unified_Individual_Id from the calculated insight.
- Consider removing repeat values from your source data and ingesting data into Data Cloud again.
- Consider filtering out repeat values using a formula field in Data Streams.

********************************************************************************************************/
SELECT
 UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual_Id__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c) AS cnt_Lineage__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__FirstName__c) AS unq_FirstNames__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(UnifiedContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_PhoneCPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(UnifiedContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_EmailCPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(UnifiedContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_AddressCPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_PartyIdentifiers__c
FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
 LEFT JOIN  IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN  UnifiedContactPointPhone__dlm ON UnifiedContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c 
 LEFT JOIN  UnifiedContactPointEmail__dlm ON UnifiedContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c 
 LEFT JOIN  UnifiedContactPointAddress__dlm ON UnifiedContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c 
 LEFT JOIN  ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm ON  ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c 
 LEFT JOIN  ssot__Individual__dlm ON  ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c =  IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c
GROUP BY 
 Unified_Individual_Id__c

Created Date: 9/3/2025

SELECT
 ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__AddressLine1__c AS AddressLine1__c,

 ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__CountryId__c AS CountryId__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT( ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c ) AS unq_Individuals__c,

SELECT
  COUNT(ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementDateTm__c) AS count__c,
  ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__EmailAddress__c AS contact_point_email__c,
  ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementChannelId__c AS engagement_channel__c,
  ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementChannelActionId__c AS engagement_channel_action__c,

SELECT

  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Saved_Quote__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Saved_Quote__c,

  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.App_Downloaded__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS App_Downloaded__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Purchased__c,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%no call%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%not call%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%ex customer%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%ex-customer%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%do not call%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%wrong number%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%not in service%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%number not%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%number did not work%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%already a customer%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Called__c,
  CASE WHEN Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Tags_c__c LIKE '%next_best_action_answer%' THEN 1 WHEN Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Tags_c__c LIKE '%next_best_action_no_answer%' THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%answered%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%spoke%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%said %' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%told %' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%talked%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%went with%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%already has%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%already got%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%already secured%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%already purchased%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%not interested%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%shopping%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%will reach%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%busy%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%interested%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%declin%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%elsewhere%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%another insurer%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%price%' OR LOWER(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Comments__c) LIKE '%coverage%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Call_Reached__c,
  MAX(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c) AS Ticket_Created_At__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Created__c,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Days_Create_To_Call__c,
  MAX(HOUR(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Hour__c,
  MAX(DAYOFWEEK(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Day_Of_Week__c,
  MAX(MONTH(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Created_Month__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS Max_Quote_Step__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Credit_Score__c) AS Credit_Score__c,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c < Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Emails_Before_Call__c,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c < Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.Opened__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Opens_Before_Call__c,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c < Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.Clicked__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Clicks_Before_Call__c,
  COUNT(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Id_c__c) AS Row_Count__c
FROM Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm
JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm ON (ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c = Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Lead__c)
LEFT JOIN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm ON (ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EmailName__c LIKE 'AC_%')
WHERE Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Subject_c__c LIKE 'New Lead- Next Best Action%'
  AND Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Lead__c <> ''
  AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), Zen_Desk_Ticket_Bronze__dlm.Created_at_c__c) >= 3
GROUP BY Lead_Id__c, Ticket_Id__c, Contact_Type__c, State__c, Previous_Insurance__c, Vehicle_Make__c, UTM_Source__c, UTM_Medium__c, Lead_Source__c, Publisher__c, Email_Opt_Out__c, Declined__c, Saved_Quote__c, Currently_Insured__c, Mobile_Opt_Out__c, App_Downloaded__c, Purchased__c, Called__c, Call_Reached__c

calculatedInsights.displayName: Data Quality CI: Summary by Source
calculatedInsights.description: Review the number of unique contact points per data source. The number of unique contact points is the number of source records consolidated in identity resolution. Use this calculated insight after data ingestion, but before creating an identity resoluti
calculatedInsights.expression:
/****************************************************************************************************************
Data Quality Calculated Insight: Summary by Source
https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=data.c360_a_resolution_troubleshooting_ci_summary_by_source.htm&type=5
Created Date: 9/3/2025
Created By: Jim Ziller - Cognizant

Tip
If you’re matching on the Device DMO and Advertiser Id field add additional JOINS to the Contact Point App object to your calculated insight.
If any contact point columns return 0, review your mappings to the Individual DMO for the data source in Data Streams.

****************************************************************************************************************/

SELECT 
 ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__DataSourceId__c AS DataSourceId__c,
 ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__DataSourceObjectId__c AS DataSourceObjectId__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_Individuals__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_PhoneCPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_EmailCPs__c, 
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_AddressCPs__c,
 APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS unq_PartyIdentifiers__c
FROM ssot__Individual__dlm
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm
  ON ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c 
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm
  ON ssot__ContactPointEmail__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm
  ON ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
 LEFT JOIN ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm
  ON ssot__PartyIdentification__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
GROUP BY 
 DataSourceId__c,
 DataSourceObjectId__c

SELECT
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Recency_Days__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c AS CreatedDate__c,
  UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual_Id__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Lead_Id__c,
  CASE 
    WHEN ISNOTNULL(
      LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
      OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
            ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
    )
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END AS Has_Subsequent_Lead__c,
  ABS(DATEDIFF(
    ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
    LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
    OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
          ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
  )) AS Days_To_Next_Lead__c,
  CASE 
    WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(
      ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
      LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
      OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
            ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
    )) <= 180
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END AS Has_Requoted_within_180_Days__c,
  COUNT(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Row_Count__c,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
    ORDER BY MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) DESC
  ) AS Row_Number__c,
  CASE
    WHEN 
      (CASE 
         WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(
           ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
           LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
           OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                 ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
         )) <= 180
         THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
       END) = TRUE
    OR
      (CASE 
         WHEN ISNOTNULL(
           LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
           OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                 ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
         )
         THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
       END) = TRUE
    OR
      (CASE
         WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(
           ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
           LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
           OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                 ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
         )) IS NULL THEN 9999
         ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(
           ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
           LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)
           OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                 ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)
         ))
       END) <= 30
    THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END AS Eligible_to_Requote_Label__c
FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
LEFT JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm 
  ON (UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c)
LEFT JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm 
  ON (IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c)
GROUP BY
  Lead_Recency_Days__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
  UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c

SELECT
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Lead_Id__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Test_Arm__c AS Test_Arm__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Assignment__c AS Assignment__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Test_Arm__c IN ('CALL_SMS', 'CALL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Call_Arm__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Test_Arm__c IN ('CALL_SMS', 'SMS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SMS_Arm__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__StateProvinceId__c AS State__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Previous_Insurance__c AS Previous_Insurance__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Vehicle_Make__c AS Vehicle_Make__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Source__c AS UTM_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c AS UTM_Medium__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__LeadSourceId__c AS Lead_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Publisher__c AS Publisher__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Declined__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Declined__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Saved_Quote__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Saved_Quote__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Currently_Insured_Status__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Currently_Insured__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.App_Downloaded__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS App_Downloaded__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Purchased__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased_Date__c IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased_Date__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased_Date__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Purchased_30d__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c) AS Entry_At__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Created__c,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Days_Create_To_Entry__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_Email_Model_Score__c) AS Entry_Email_Model_Score__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_Call_Score__c) AS Entry_Call_Score__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_Email_Score__c) AS Entry_Email_Score__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_SMS_Score__c) AS Entry_SMS_Score__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased_Date__c) AS Purchased_Date__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS Max_Quote_Step__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Credit_Score__c) AS Credit_Score__c,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EmailName__c LIKE 'AC_Review%' AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.Opened__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Review_Emails_Opened__c,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__EmailName__c LIKE 'AC_Review%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Review_Emails_Sent__c,
  COUNT(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Row_Count__c
FROM ssot__Lead__dlm
LEFT JOIN ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm ON (ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__LeadlId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AND ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c >= ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c)
WHERE ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Test_Arm__c IN ('CALL_SMS', 'CALL', 'SMS')
  AND ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Assignment__c = 'RANDOM'
  AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.NBA_Entry_At__c) >= 30
GROUP BY Lead_Id__c, Test_Arm__c, Assignment__c, Call_Arm__c, SMS_Arm__c, State__c, Previous_Insurance__c, Vehicle_Make__c, UTM_Source__c, UTM_Medium__c, Lead_Source__c, Publisher__c, Declined__c, Saved_Quote__c, Currently_Insured__c, App_Downloaded__c, Purchased__c, Purchased_30d__c

SELECT
            UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c,
            SUM(ssot__Lead__dlm.of_Calls_to_CC__c) AS of_Calls_to_CC__c,
            SUM(ssot__Lead__dlm.of_SMS_Delivered__c) AS of_SMS_Delivered__c,

        FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
        JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm 
            ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c
        LEFT JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm 
            ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c
	GROUP BY

SELECT
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Lead_Id__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__StateProvinceId__c AS State__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Previous_Insurance__c AS Previous_Insurance__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Vehicle_Make__c AS Vehicle_Make__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Source__c AS UTM_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c AS UTM_Medium__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__LeadSourceId__c AS Lead_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Publisher__c AS Publisher__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Email_Opt_Out__c AS Email_Opt_Out__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Declined__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Declined__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Saved_Quote__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Saved_Quote__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Currently_Insured_Status__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Currently_Insured__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Mobile_Opt_Out__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Mobile_Opt_Out__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__MobileContactPhoneId__c IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Has_Mobile__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.App_Downloaded__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS App_Downloaded__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Purchased__c,
  CASE WHEN first_call.First_Call_At__c IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(first_call.First_Call_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(first_call.First_Call_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Called_Us_30d__c,
  CASE WHEN first_call.First_Call_At__c IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(first_call.First_Call_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(first_call.First_Call_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Called_Us_90d__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Created__c,
  MAX(first_call.First_Call_At__c) AS First_Call_At__c,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(first_call.First_Call_At__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Days_Create_To_Call__c,
  MAX(HOUR(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Hour__c,
  MAX(DAYOFWEEK(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Day_Of_Week__c,
  MAX(MONTH(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Created_Month__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS Max_Quote_Step__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Credit_Score__c) AS Credit_Score__c,
  COUNT(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Row_Count__c
FROM ssot__Lead__dlm
LEFT JOIN (SELECT IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c AS Lead_Id__c, MIN(Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Created_at_c__c) AS First_Call_At__c FROM Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON (IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c = Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Unified_Individual_ID__c) JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm ON (ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c) WHERE Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Unified_Individual_ID__c <> '' AND Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Subject_c__c NOT LIKE 'New Lead- Next Best Action%' AND (Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Subject_c__c LIKE '%Call from%' OR Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Via_c__c = 'Api') AND Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Created_at_c__c >= ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c GROUP BY IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c) AS first_call ON (first_call.Lead_Id__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c)
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) >= 31
  AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) <= 1040
  AND (ssot__Lead__dlm.Internal_Traffic__c IS NULL OR ssot__Lead__dlm.Internal_Traffic__c = FALSE)
GROUP BY Lead_Id__c, State__c, Previous_Insurance__c, Vehicle_Make__c, UTM_Source__c, UTM_Medium__c, Lead_Source__c, Publisher__c, Email_Opt_Out__c, Declined__c, Saved_Quote__c, Currently_Insured__c, Mobile_Opt_Out__c, Has_Mobile__c, App_Downloaded__c, Purchased__c, Called_Us_30d__c, Called_Us_90d__c

SELECT
  COUNT(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementDateTm__c) AS datetime__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementChannelActionId__c AS engagement_channel_action__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementDateTm__c AS engagement_date_time__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementEventDirectionId__c AS engagement_event_direction__c,
  ssot__ContactPointPhone__dlm.ssot__FormattedE164PhoneNumber__c AS mobilenumber__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__CountryId__c AS country__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__IsTestSend__c AS is_test_send__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.IsValid__c AS is_valid__c,
  ssot__SMSTemplate__dlm.ssot__Name__c AS name__c
FROM ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm
  JOIN ssot__SMSTemplate__dlm
    ON (ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementAssetId__c = ssot__SMSTemplate__dlm.ssot__Id__c AND ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.KQ_EngagementAssetId__c = ssot__SMSTemplate__dlm.KQ_Id__c)

GROUP BY

  country__c,
  is_test_send__c,

SELECT GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm.appFeedback__c AS app_feedback__c, GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c AS prompt_template__c, GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateVersionNo__c AS prompt_template_version__c,
GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedback__c AS feedback__c, COUNT(GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateVersionNo__c) AS counts__c
FROM GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm
    FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIFeedback__dlm ON (GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm.parent__c = GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedbackId__c)
    FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGeneration__dlm ON (GenAIFeedback__dlm.generationId__c = GenAIGeneration__dlm.generationId__c) 
    FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm ON (GenAIGeneration__dlm.generationResponseId__c = GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm.generationResponseId__c) 
    FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm ON (GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm.generationRequestId__c = GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.gatewayRequestId__c)
WHERE GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c  IS NOT NULL
AND GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedback__c = 'BAD'
GROUP BY prompt_template__c, prompt_template_version__c, feedback__c, app_feedback__c

/*
===============================================================================
 Script Name   : Unified Individual Quote Attribute Step7
 Created By    : Jim Ziller (Contractor, Cognizant)
 Created Date  : 2025-08-14
 Last Updated  : 2025-08-18
 Description   : 
   This query aggregates quote and lead data for unified individuals across 
   all quote steps. It calculates metrics such as total lead count, time 
   between leads, and the most recent quote date. The logic has been updated 
   to ensure accurate roll-up to the individual level by using nested subqueries:
     - SUB2 captures row-level lead details including CreatedDate and QuoteID.
     - SUB1 summarizes lead activity per individual.
     - The final query performs top-level aggregations to ensure all metrics 
       are treated as measures in Salesforce Data Cloud Calculated Insights.
   This structure supports reliable analysis of quoting behavior and engagement 
   patterns across time, grouped by individual, month, and quarter.
===============================================================================
*/


SELECT 
    SUB1.UnifiedIndividualId__c as UnifiedIndividualId__c ,
    MAX(SUB1.LastStep7QuoteDate__c) AS LastQuoteDate__c,
    MONTH(SUB1.LastStep7QuoteDate__c) AS LastStep7QuoteMonth__c,
    QUARTER(SUB1.LastStep7QuoteDate__c) AS LastStep7QuoteQuarter__c,
    MAX(SUB1.Step7_Lead_Count__c) AS Step7_Lead_Count__c,
    MAX(SUB1.AvgDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c) AS AvgDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c,
    MAX(SUB1.MinDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c) AS MinDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c,
    MAX(SUB1.MaxDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c) AS MaxDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c

FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUB2.UnifiedIndividualId__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c ,
	AVG(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS AvgDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c,
	MAX(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MaxDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c,
	MIN(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MinDaysSincePreviousStep7Lead__c,
	COUNT(SUB2.QuoteID__c) as Step7_Lead_Count__c,
	MAX(SUB2.LeadCreatedDate__c) AS LastStep7QuoteDate__c


    FROM (
        SELECT
            UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c,
            ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c AS LeadCreatedDate__c,
	    ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS QuoteID__c,
            DATEDIFF(
                ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
                LAG(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                    ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC
                )
            ) AS DaysSincePreviousLead__c

        FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
        JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm 
            ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c
        LEFT JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm 
            ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c
        WHERE ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c = 7	
        GROUP BY 
	     UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c,  
	     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c, 
	     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c
    ) AS SUB2

    GROUP BY SUB2.UnifiedIndividualId__c
) AS SUB1

GROUP BY SUB1.UnifiedIndividualId__c,     MONTH(SUB1.LastStep7QuoteDate__c) ,
    QUARTER(SUB1.LastStep7QuoteDate__c)

SELECT
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS max_quote__c,
  UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS lead__c
FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
  JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm
    ON (UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c)
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm
    ON (IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c)
GROUP BY lead__c

SELECT 
     DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ) AS Lead_Recency_Days__c, 
     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c AS CreatedDate__c, 
     UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual_Id__c,
     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Lead_Id__c,
     CASE WHEN
          ISNOTNULL (LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                    ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC)) THEN TRUE
     ELSE FALSE
          END AS Has_Subsequent_Lead__c,
     ABS(DATEDIFF(
          ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
          LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) OVER (
          PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
          ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC   )
            )) AS Days_To_Next_Lead__c,
     CASE WHEN
          ABS(DATEDIFF(
                ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
                LEAD(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) OVER (
                PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC))) <= 180 THEN TRUE
          ELSE FALSE
      END AS Has_Requoted_within_180_Days__c,
     COUNT(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Row_Count__c,
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c ORDER BY MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)            DESC) AS Row_Number__c

FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm 
LEFT JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON (UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c ) 
LEFT JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm ON ( IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) 
GROUP BY  
     Lead_Recency_Days__c, 
     UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c, 
     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c,
     ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c

/*
===============================================================================
 Script Name   : Unified Individual Quote Attributes
 Created By    : Jim Ziller (Contractor, Cognizant)
 Created Date  : 2025-08-14
 Last Updated  : 2025-08-18
 Description   : 
   This query aggregates quote and lead data for unified individuals across 
   all quote steps. It calculates metrics such as total lead count, time 
   between leads, and the most recent quote date. The logic has been updated 
   to ensure accurate roll-up to the individual level by using nested subqueries:
     - SUB2 captures row-level lead details including CreatedDate and QuoteID.
     - SUB1 summarizes lead activity per individual.
     - The final query performs top-level aggregations to ensure all metrics 
       are treated as measures in Salesforce Data Cloud Calculated Insights.
   This structure supports reliable analysis of quoting behavior and engagement 
   patterns across time, grouped by individual, month, and quarter.
===============================================================================
*/


SELECT 
    SUB1.UnifiedIndividualId__c as UnifiedIndividualId__c ,
    MAX(SUB1.MaxStepReached__c) AS MaxStepReached__c,
    MAX(SUB1.LastQuoteDate__c) AS LastQuoteDate__c,
    MONTH(SUB1.LastQuoteDate__c) AS LastQuoteMonth__c,
    QUARTER(SUB1.LastQuoteDate__c) AS LastQuoteQuarter__c,

    MAX(SUB1.Lead_Count__c) AS Lead_Count__c,
    MAX(SUB1.AvgDaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS AvgDaysSincePreviousLead__c,
    MAX(SUB1.MinDaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MinDaysSincePreviousLead__c,
    MAX(SUB1.MaxDaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MaxDaysSincePreviousLead__c

FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUB2.UnifiedIndividualId__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c ,
        MAX(SUB2.MaxStepReached__c) AS MaxStepReached__c,
	AVG(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS AvgDaysSincePreviousLead__c,
	MAX(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MaxDaysSincePreviousLead__c,
	MIN(SUB2.DaysSincePreviousLead__c) AS MinDaysSincePreviousLead__c,
	COUNT(SUB2.QuoteID__c) as Lead_Count__c,
	MAX(SUB2.LeadCreatedDate__c) AS LastQuoteDate__c


    FROM (
        SELECT
            UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c,
            ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c AS MaxStepReached__c,
            ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c AS LeadCreatedDate__c,
	    ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS QuoteID__c,
            DATEDIFF(
                ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c,
                LAG(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
                    ORDER BY ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c ASC
                )
            ) AS DaysSincePreviousLead__c

        FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
        JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm 
            ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c
        LEFT JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm 
            ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c
	GROUP BY 
	UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c, 
	ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c, 
	ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c, 
	ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c
    ) AS SUB2

    GROUP BY SUB2.UnifiedIndividualId__c
) AS SUB1

GROUP BY SUB1.UnifiedIndividualId__c,     MONTH(SUB1.LastQuoteDate__c) ,
    QUARTER(SUB1.LastQuoteDate__c)

/*
===============================================================================
 Script Name   : Unified Individual Zen Desk Engagement
 Created By    : Jim Ziller (Contractor, Cognizant)
 Created Date  : 2025-11-10
 Last Updated  : 2025-11-10
 Description   : 
   This query aggregates Zen Desk Engagement data for unified individuals. It calculates metric total Zen Desk Engagements. 
===============================================================================
*/


       SELECT
            UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c,
            COUNT (Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Id_c__c) AS TotalZenDeskEngagement__c,
 MAX( Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.CreatedDate__c) AS LastPhoneCreatedDateTm__c

        FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
        LEFT JOIN Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm
            ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = Zen_Desk_Ticket_Gold__dlm.Unified_Individual_ID__c
	GROUP BY 
	UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c

SELECT
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Subscriber_Key__c AS Lead_Id__c,
  ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__Name__c AS SMS_Name__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__StateProvinceId__c AS State__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Previous_Insurance__c AS Previous_Insurance__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Vehicle_Make__c AS Vehicle_Make__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Source__c AS UTM_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c AS UTM_Medium__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__LeadSourceId__c AS Lead_Source__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Publisher__c AS Publisher__c,
  ssot__Lead__dlm.Email_Opt_Out__c AS Email_Opt_Out__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Declined__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Declined__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Saved_Quote__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Saved_Quote__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Currently_Insured_Status__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Currently_Insured__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.App_Downloaded__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS App_Downloaded__c,
  CASE WHEN ssot__Lead__dlm.Purchased__c = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Purchased__c,
  CASE WHEN clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c IS NOT NULL AND clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c > ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c AND DATEDIFF(clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c, ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Clicked_14d__c,
  CASE WHEN clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c IS NOT NULL AND clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c > ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c AND DATEDIFF(clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c, ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Clicked_30d__c,
  CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) >= 460 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) <= 825 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Label_Window__c,
  MAX(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) AS SMS_Sent_At__c,
  MAX(clicks.First_Click_Lead_At__c) AS First_Click_Lead_At__c,
  MAX(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.SMS_Status_Code_Id__c) AS SMS_Status_Code__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS Lead_Created__c,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c, ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Days_Create_To_SMS__c,
  MAX(HOUR(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c)) AS SMS_Hour__c,
  MAX(HOUR(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Hour__c,
  MAX(DAYOFWEEK(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Day_Of_Week__c,
  MAX(MONTH(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c)) AS Lead_Created_Month__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Max_Quote_Step__c) AS Max_Quote_Step__c,
  MAX(ssot__Lead__dlm.Credit_Score__c) AS Credit_Score__c,
  COUNT(ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS Row_Count__c
FROM ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm
JOIN ssot__Lead__dlm ON (ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c = ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Subscriber_Key__c)
LEFT JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON (IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c AS Unified_Id__c, MIN(ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__CreatedDate__c) AS First_Click_Lead_At__c FROM ssot__Lead__dlm JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON (IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Lead__dlm.ssot__Id__c) WHERE ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c = 'sms' GROUP BY IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c) AS clicks ON (clicks.Unified_Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c)
WHERE ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.ssot__Name__c LIKE 'AC_%'
  AND ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Subscriber_Key__c LIKE '00Q%'
  AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), ssot__MessageEngagement__dlm.Create_Date_Custom__c) >= 15
  AND (ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c IS NULL OR ssot__Lead__dlm.UTM_Medium__c <> 'sms')
GROUP BY Lead_Id__c, SMS_Name__c, State__c, Previous_Insurance__c, Vehicle_Make__c, UTM_Source__c, UTM_Medium__c, Lead_Source__c, Publisher__c, Email_Opt_Out__c, Declined__c, Saved_Quote__c, Currently_Insured__c, App_Downloaded__c, Purchased__c, Clicked_14d__c, Clicked_30d__c, Label_Window__c

    GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedback__c AS feedback__c, COUNT(GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c ) AS counts__c
FROM GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm
    FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIFeedback__dlm ON (GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm.parent__c = GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedbackId__c)

/*
===============================================================================
 Script Name   : Unified Individual Email Engagement
 Created By    : Jim Ziller (Contractor, Cognizant)
 Created Date  : 2025-11-19
 Last Updated  : 2025-11-19
 Description   : 
   This query aggregates email Engagement data for unified individuals. It calculates metric total email Engagements and the last engagement Date. 
===============================================================================
*/


       SELECT
            UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedIndividualId__c,
            COUNT (ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS TotalMessageEngagement__c, 
 MAX (ssot__EmailEngagement__dlm.ssot__SentDateTm__c ) as LastEmailSentDateTm__c

        FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm
        JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm
